proposal.reason: Main change is review-routing policy/automation behavior, owned by workflow: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds run-number stale-result suppression, invitation lifecycle changes (no obsolete re-request loop), and selective HTTP 422 withdrawal warning handling; .github/workflows/review-gate.yml and review-squash-preview.yml add PR-number identification/normalization and canonical per-PR concurrency locks; .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py and commit_message_squash.py add identify mode and strict positive PR parsing. .github/skills/pccl-review-assignment/modules.json only updates catalog boundaries/descriptions, which are workflow-owned metadata, not runtime copy-engine/symmetric implementation changes.
